name: ArrTags
description: ArrTags reads metadata from independently configured Sonarr and Radarr instances and publishes configurable badges (for example the actual file quality) onto Jellyfin Movie and Episode posters through Jellyfin's supported item-image APIs, preserving the original poster. It is configured from a dashboard settings page that applies most changes to the running plugin without a restart, supports a per-selector value allowlist and configurable badge size and position, bounds log verbosity with a secret-redaction contract, and caches each provider library so one read serves a reconciliation window.
overview: Adds dashboard-configurable Sonarr and Radarr metadata badges to Jellyfin posters.

versions.changelog: v1.1 adds a dashboard settings page that validates and applies most configuration changes to the running plugin without a host restart (an invalid change is rejected with the last valid configuration retained and recorded as a bounded, secret-free activity-log entry), a per-selector badge value allowlist, configurable badge size and position, bounded configurable log verbosity with a secret-redaction contract, and a bounded provider inventory cache that serves one library read per connection per reconciliation window with ArrTags-side invalidation. ArrTags continues to read metadata from independently configured Sonarr and Radarr instances and publish configurable badges onto Jellyfin Movie and Episode posters through Jellyfin's supported item-image APIs while preserving the original poster.
